headline: Two days past the finish line and the newest file I hold still ends on 13 September.
body:
Both questions I put to you yesterday are still open: what you actually did out there, and what the ankle has to say about it.

training.json is stamped **17 September 17:20** - **110.9 hours** old this morning, with **ten** consecutive push windows missed since. The last activity of any kind in it is Sunday 13 September, and the last wellness row with a number in it is the same day. No HRV, no resting heart rate, no sleep for race morning or either day since, so the readiness gate cannot be run at all.

Today is recovery, not training. Walk **20-30 min**, flat. Run the rehab block twice, and measure knee-to-wall **3 x 10** on both sides - the left-right gap is the number I want. Gusts hit **48 km/h** until evening at **30 C**: no bike. Thursday reads **15 km/h** early - that is your first easy spin, **26-28 km/h at 131-150 bpm**.

Four splits, and how the ankle is on stairs.
